purpose: Route the complete raw Impress command inventory into product-level families, track release-evidence maturity, and distinguish it from AI tool exposure. Raw UNO commands are evidence inputs, not an AI API.

engineBaseline.product: Collabora Online cp-26.04.4-1 source / stock CODE 26.04.3.2.1 runtime

states.runtime_verified: Typed operation, permission check, live readback, native Undo and browser-session probe all pass.
states.runtime_verified_auxiliary_tool: The same safety and browser-session gates pass, but the operation still travels through a specialized asset tool rather than the native edit schema.
states.engine_patch_ready: A bounded adapter and isolated source patch exist for the declared undo-v level. Promotion still requires the compiled native suite, browser Undo/save/reopen/playback evidence where applicable, and independent PowerPoint release validation.
states.format_excluded: The human editor may expose a local property, but the target document format has no interoperable representation, so AI mutation is intentionally unavailable.
states.observation_verified: The live browser editor exposes stable, bounded structure for this family and the observation was checked on a representative public PPTX; mutation safety is a separate state.
states.runtime_validation_required: A bounded typed adapter exists and its immediate browser transaction passes, but save/reopen, visual or native-application release gates remain.
states.typed_adapter_required: The human editor has the capability, but the AI still needs a bounded schema, readback and Undo test.
states.observation_required: Safe execution depends on first exposing the relevant structure and stable targets.
states.visual_validation_required: Deterministic structure checks are insufficient; render or media-specific review is required.
states.platform_owned: The product platform, not the model, owns this lifecycle operation.
states.human_ui_only: Useful editor state that should not be an AI document mutation.
states.security_excluded: Intentionally unavailable to document AI because it expands authority beyond the document contract.

rawUiCommandRouting.policy: Every observed Impress UI command is routed to a product semantic family. Routing proves inventory coverage only; it does not make a raw UNO command an AI tool or satisfy that family's runtime release gates.

aiToolExposure.runtimeGuard: The connector checks the live editor patch level and document permission before every operation.

runtimeVerifiedAuxiliaryTools.reason: Image generation and binary asset delivery are platform-mediated. Live revision, target slide, permission, exact one-image insertion, native Undo and Redo pass, but the operation has not yet been unified with native_edit/native_batch_edit.

semanticFamilies.scope: zoom, panes, ruler, guides, selection, slide show and presenter state

semanticFamilies.scope: save as, export, PDF, print, email and remote-file commands
semanticFamilies.decision: Use server-authoritative candidate validation and download/export APIs, never raw editor file or network commands.

releaseRule: An operation or transaction mode moves into the public runtime contract only after typed schema, permission enforcement, revision binding, exact live readback, native Undo/Redo, failed-batch rollback and browser-session verification all pass. Visual families additionally require rendered review, and engine_patch_ready behavior requires a patched Collabora image probe.
